_README: FROZEN controlled-vocabulary baseline generated from gear-planner raw (U10/KTD9). The referential-integrity gate validates re-imports against THIS checked-in file (not a fresh regen), so a new upstream name is a build-blocking event. Regenerate deliberately + review the diff on re-import.
_local_names_why: REPO-MINTED affix names the frozen baseline above cannot contain (#374/KTD5). generate_registries() reads the RAW gear-planner files, before any rename runs, so a name this repo mints with a pipeline rename can never appear in `affix_names` once upstream stops emitting it. Two consumers then break, and only one of them shouts: check_referential_integrity resolves through affix_aliases.json FIRST and then requires registry membership (Rule A -> IntegrityError), while cross_add_map BOUNDS its lore targets to the known vocabulary and drops an absent one SILENTLY. This section is unioned into both: src/vocabulary.check_referential_integrity (loading this file directly -- its caller builds the baseline from raw and would never carry the section) and build_dataset.load_affix_vocabulary, whose registry feeds cross_add_map. LEGITIMACY, asserted mechanically by local_affix_names(): a name here must be either the `canonical_name` of an affix_name_corrections.json entry OR the `name` of a `local_affix_synonyms` entry in affix_synonyms_registry.json -- the two files this repo mints names in. Anything else is an invented affix and is rejected. A `pending_upstream` correction COUNTS as a minting source: every canon-defence entry is pending by construction until U4 vendors the refreshed snapshot, so requiring a retired marker would reject exactly the names this section exists to protect -- and the marker means 'the data has not armed it yet', not 'unverified' (each entry carries its wiki evidence, and assert_canon_defense fails the moment the marker outlives the data). Every name below is STILL in `affix_names` today, so the union is a no-op until the refresh lands; it is declared ahead of the data deliberately, so the refresh is a data change rather than a migration. Two canonicals are deliberately NOT minted: `Legendary Conditioning` (native upstream, so it stays in the baseline -- minting it would be a permanent no-op) and `Enhanced Ki` (absent from the baseline today, but untyped upstream and therefore invisible to the gate's walk; it belongs with issue #229, which owns that blindness, not here).

local_affix_names.name: Damage to helpless enemies
local_affix_names.evidence: docs/wiki-evidence/helpless-damage.md (#305): the ddowiki Helpless hub page lists every gear source of the one percent-extra-damage mechanic, and this is the spelling the Solar Gem of Cruelty affixes carry natively. Backed by BOTH arms -- the `Damage vs. the Helpless` -> `Damage to helpless enemies` correction and the local_affix_synonyms entry of the same name in affix_synonyms_registry.json (which folds eleven spellings onto it).

local_affix_names.name: Legendary Conditioning
local_affix_names.evidence: docs/wiki-evidence/ and PR #377 (#376): `Conditioning` is the percentage Legendary bonus to Maximum Hit Points; `Legendary Conditioning` is its raw pre-fold spelling, which legendary_fold turns into `Conditioning`. Minted by the `False Life (%)` correction. The 2026-08-18 refresh dropped it from raw (34 -> 0) and added an upstream fold to `False Life (%)`, so it is also in vocabulary.PROTECTED_CANON.

local_affix_names.name: Enhanced Ki
local_affix_names.evidence: docs/plans/2026-08-10-001-fix-unreachable-affix-vocabulary-plan.md U1 (#227): the wiki names the enchantment `Enhanced Ki`; upstream stores bare `Ki`. Minted by the `Ki` correction. Dormant until the 2026-08-18 refresh typed the 20 `Ki` records, lifting #229's mask and arming the alias.
